sourceLines.rawText: Buy from the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Pot of flour|1}} + {{GEP|Bucket of milk|1}} + {{GEP|Egg|1}}}}
Create them yourself:
[[Bucket of milk]]: use a [[bucket]] (found in the cellar of [[Lumbridge castle]]) on a [[dairy cow]] in the [[Lumbridge cow field]].
[[Egg]]: spawns at the chicken farm north-west of the cow field.

[[Pot of flour]]: with an [[empty pot]] (found by the Cook in Lumbridge Castle), head to the [[Mill Lane Mill]] next to the cow pens and pick some [[grain]] from outside. Climb up to the top floor of the mill and use the grain with the hopper, then pull the lever. Climb down and take the flour from the flour bin with an [[empty pot]].
Talk to the [[Cook (Lumbridge)|Cook]] in [[Lumbridge Castle]]'s kitchen with all the items in your inventory. {{Chat option|1What's Wrong?|1Can I help?}}
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}

actions.displayText: Talk to Marlo at the Varrock Estate Agent to start the miniquest.
Pick up the nearby saw if you did not bring one.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo in his house south-west of Aubury's Rune Shop.
Remove all seven old hotspots: the broken chair, rotten carpet, two stools, two tables, and campbed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again; you may skip his lecture.
Search the marked kitchen crates for 3 waxwood logs.
Talk to the Sawmill operator and turn the 3 waxwood logs into waxwood planks.
Prepare 10 planks, 16 construction nails, and 5 bolts of cloth through RuneProof.
Ask Old Man Yarlo for a hammer and saw if you did not bring them.
Lay the new carpet.
Build the new wooden furniture at the white translucent hotspots.
Build the waxwood bed.
Talk to Old Man Yarlo after all three construction branches are complete.
Return to Marlo and claim your reward.
Daddy's Home complete.

sourceLines.rawText: Pick up a [[saw]] here if you didn't bring one.
Talk to [[Old Man Yarlo]] in his house south-west of [[Aubury's Rune Shop]].
Remove all of the old furniture in the house, for a total of 7 hotspots: 6 pieces of furniture and a rug.
one broken chair
one rotten carpet
two broken stools
two broken tables
one campbed
Talk to Old Man Yarlo again. {{Chat option|2Skip Yarlo's lecture. He'll offer it later if you like.}}
Search the [[crates (Daddy's Home)|crates]] with the black symbol on them west of the range for 3 [[waxwood log]]s.
Go to the [[Varrock sawmill]] and talk to the [[Sawmill operator]]. {{Chat option|1I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.}}
Make 3 [[waxwood plank]]s using the waxwood logs.
Make 10 [[plank]]s now if you don't already have them.
Purchase your [[steel nails]] and five [[bolts of cloth]] now if you need them.
Go to Old Man Yarlo's home and build the new furniture (all white translucent objects).
Talk to Old Man Yarlo for a [[hammer]] and a [[saw]] if you didn't bring them. {{Chat option|3I need some tools.|1Yes please.}}
Talk to Old Man Yarlo.
Talk to Marlo to claim your reward. {{Chat option|1Yeah, what have you got for me?}}
'''Congratulations, miniquest complete!'''}}

actions.displayText: The Wiki lists buying the required materials from the Grand Exchange as one option.
Talk to Doric to start the quest.
Prepare 2 iron ore, 4 copper ore, and 6 clay through RuneProof.
Low-level players should beware of aggressive scorpions and bring food if required.
Return to Doric with the un-noted iron ore, copper ore, and clay.
Doric's Quest complete.

sourceLines.rawText: Buy from the [[Grand Exchange]] for: {{Coins|{{GEP|Iron ore|2}} + {{GEP|Copper ore|4}} + {{GEP|Clay|6}}}}
Head to the [[Dwarven Mine]] on the south side of the Ice mountain (east from the quest start) with a [[pickaxe]] (Doric will give you a [[bronze pickaxe]] at the start of the quest):
2 [[iron ore]]s and 4 [[copper ore]]s can be mined at a spot just south-east of the ladder down into the mine.
6 [[clay]] can be mined south of the iron and copper, near the [[Agility]] [[shortcut]].
Players with very low combat levels should be wary of the aggressive [[Scorpion|Scorpions]] and [[King Scorpion|King Scorpions]]. Bring food if required.
Talk to [[Doric]] with the '''un-noted''' items in your inventory. {{Chat option|1I wanted to use your anvils.|1Yes, I will get you the materials.}}
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}

sourceLines.rawText: In [[Seers' Village]], go to the house immediately south of the anvil.
Search the [[bookcase (Elemental Workshop I)|bookcase]] on the eastern wall to find a [[battered book]].
Read the book, then use a [[knife]] on it to get a [[Battered key]].
There is a knife spawn in the house north of the church if you forgot to bring one.
'''Note:''' You'll need the book later, so don't get rid of it.
Go to the building with anvil and open the Odd looking wall in the north (with the key in inventory).
Go down the stairs.
Go into the room to the north.
Turn the water controls east of the water wheel.
Turn the water controls west of the water wheel.
Pull the lever by the water wheel.

(Optional) Kill one of each of the Elemental to complete Kandarin Easy Task. For the Earth Elemental, you must defeat one of the actual Elementals walking around; the rock that turns into the Elemental won't count towards the requirement.
(Optional) To obtain [[leather]], search a [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, leather)|crate]] north of the staircase in the middle room.
(Optional) To obtain a [[needle]], search the [[Crate (Elemental Workshop I, needle)|two stacked crates]] on the left as you enter the west room.
Go to the eastern room.
With a [[needle]], [[thread]], and [[leather]], fix the bellows.
Pull the lever by the bellows.
Go to the middle room and search the [[Boxes (Elemental Workshop)|boxes]] in the north-east to get [[a stone bowl]].
Go to the south room.
Use a stone bowl on the lava trough to the south.
Use the bowl of lava on the [[Furnace]] in the room.
Go to the western room and mine an [[elemental rock]].
Kill the [[Earth elemental]] and pick up the [[elemental ore]] it drops (get 2 more ores if you are planning to do [[Elemental Workshop II/Quick guide|Elemental Workshop II]]).
Use the elemental ore and four [[coal]] on the furnace in the southern room. You will get an [[Elemental metal]].
With the [[slashed book]], go to the middle room and smith an [[elemental shield]] by using the [[Elemental Bar|elemental metal]] on the workbench.
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''

sourceLines.rawText: Buy them from the [[Grand Exchange]] for {{Coins|{{GEP|Red bead|1}} + {{GEP|Black bead|1}} + {{GEP|Yellow bead|1}} + {{GEP|White bead|1}}}}

Kill [[imp]]s, recommended for free players either near the southern entrance to [[Falador]] or the top of the [[Karamja volcano]]; or for members east of the [[Ardougne Monastery]], at the entrance of [[Chasm of Fire]], or around the [[Charcoal furnace]]
Talk to [[Wizard Mizgog]] on the top floor of the [[Wizards' Tower]] with all four beads in your inventory.{{Chat option|1 Give me a quest please.|1 Yes.}}
'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''}}
